name: EffectForce
author: Devko
summary: A live looper and an Octatrack-style performance mixer in one insert slot: the looper records the next bars on MPC's grid (or keeps the bar just played) and plays, layers, rolls (1/2 to 1/32), slows, stops or reverses them; a crossfader (learn the Force's own to it) blends two scenes from a library of 64 one-tap effects (filter sweeps, echo throws, washes, rolls, tape stops, gates), whose sweeps and risers move by themselves from the next bar line. Underneath, a ten-module effect rack in any order (drive, filter, EQ, compressor / OTT, chorus, phaser / flanger, tremolo / gate, granular, delay, shimmer reverb) with macros, LFOs and an 8-slot mod matrix; 62 presets and a 14-page touchscreen skin with Q-Links.
